baguio-cathedral.scope: The cathedral building: twin towers with spires, nave, transept, apse and entrance porch.

baguio-city-hall.scope: The City Hall building on its OSM outline with dark-green hip roofs, the four-column portico and stair, and the clock tower.

baguio-museum.scope: The Baguio Museum building: plank walls, broad grey hip roof, and the entrance pavilion with two stone poles, stair and glazed upper box.

baguio-public-market.scope: The City Market complex: every OSM building inside the market outline, with varied corrugated roofs and the Hangar Market's barrel vault.

bencab-museum.scope: The BenCab Museum building: dark slate terraces stepping down the hillside, white roof slabs, the entrance canopy and the red sign.

botanical-garden.scope: The entrance quarter: the bronze name wall, the walk down to the round Centennial Garden plaza, the main walks, the Orchidarium, the native huts, the greenhouse and pines.

burnham-park.scope: Burnham Park around the lake: the lake, its rim, boats, stalls and pavilion, and the lawns, gardens, walks, bike and kart tracks, kiosks and trees from the lake north to Igorot Garden.

camp-john-hay.scope: The historic core: the Bell Amphitheater (terraces, lawn, gazebo, stairway) and the Bell House (clapboard, green hip roofs, raised veranda), with pines.

diplomat-hotel-ruins.scope: The Diplomat Hotel ruins, from OSM's Simple 3D Buildings parts: walls with window openings, crenellated parapets, courtyards, centre block with crosses and the arched porch.

good-shepherd-convent.scope: The Mountain Maid Training Center (white, green-trimmed, shop canopies), the planted wall, the Good Shepherd statue and the view deck.

igorot-stone-kingdom.scope: The Igorot Stone Kingdom: fieldstone tiers stepping down the gully, pinnacled and crenellated walls, the legend tower and the round arena with its fountain.

la-trinidad-strawberry-farms.scope: The pick-your-own strawberry field (mulched beds, low tunnels, shade-net fence) by the farm's parking, and the giant strawberry sculpture.

osm_center.source: OSM node/8932902319 "Strawberry Farm" (the visitor farm by its parking), Overpass name search 2026-10-05

lions-head-kennon-road.scope: The Lion's Head sculpture and its plinth by Kennon Road: gold mane, brown face, eyes, muzzle, fanged mouth and clawed paw.

lourdes-grotto.scope: The grotto (rock, niche, statue, sign arch, altar), its plaza, the stairway with twin flights and blue rails, and the Chapel of Jesus and Maria.

mile-hi-cjh-viewdeck.scope: The Mile Hi Center: the single-storey arcade of shops (former commissary) with its covered walkway, rust-red roofs, flower bed and pines.

mines-view-park.scope: The observation deck on the cliff edge: stone paving on a rock base, log railings, the timber tepee with its red slat canopy and eagle, the rock face, the stepped walkway and pines.

philippine-military-academy.scope: Borromeo Field (the parade ground) and the Tirso G. Fajardo Memorial Grandstand with its blue COURAGE · INTEGRITY · LOYALTY band, flags and fence.

session-road.scope: Session Road corridor: both carriageways with markings, planted median with trees and lamps, sidewalks and awnings.

tam-awan-village.scope: Tam-awan Village: seven Ifugao huts, the mapped houses as thatched houses on posts (one the octagonal binayon), and trees.

teachers-camp.scope: The Teachers Camp Athletic Oval: the track and grass infield draped on the terrain, ringed by pines.

the-mansion.scope: The Mansion House (H plan, arcade, green hip roof, parapeted wings), its front lawn, and the wrought-iron main gate up the axis.

wright-park.scope: The Pool of Pines: the stepped reflecting pool, its rim, brick promenades and verges, potted shrubs and pine rows.

sm-city-baguio.scope: SM City Baguio: the mall's three terrace tiers in sage-green cladding with floor bands, shopfronts and covered walkways, the curved glazed entrance with its sign, the Sky Park's membrane tents and lawns, and Sky Ranch's Baguio Eye, drop tower, carousel and Viking ride.

baguio-athletic-bowl.scope: The Baguio Athletic Bowl and the park's south: the football pitch inside the running track, the grandstand, tennis courts, pool hall, library, and the Pine Trees of the World woods.

burnham-park-fields.scope: Burnham Park between the lake and the Athletic Bowl: the roofed skating rink, the Children's Playground with its play equipment, the bike and pedal-kart areas, lawns, walks and woods.

burnham-park-west.scope: Burnham Park's west side: the Orchidarium and its greenhouses, Ibaloi Park, the gardens, lawns, walks and trees.

burnham-park-east.scope: Burnham Park's east side: the open football field before the Melvin Jones Grandstand, the grandstand, lawns, walks and trees.
